name: t512_unknown_diffusion

question.text: Benchmark nonlinear inference with interval readings, sparse data and a replayed deterministic accumulator. Identify the input effect on the outcome.

data.context: Production-simulated readings with explicitly masked values. Import anchors and support unchanged; never aggregate or fill gaps. Point instruments use the declared three-hour cadence; missing rows are not observed times.

allowed_findings.C2 latent scale: One generating replicate has zero across-replicate variance; this screen does not assess a one-history design.
allowed_findings.C5c transmission: The interval count instrument intentionally carries little temporal information (1.4% in seed 721); Gaussian point and interval channels carry the signal.
allowed_findings.sample_size: The exact driver reading and known accumulator origin each intentionally have one observation.
allowed_findings.large_timestamp_gap: Accumulator readings are intentionally sparse (every 32 grid intervals plus the final node); the original supports and all gaps remain recorded.

unavailable_findings.NO_OBSERVATIONS: Truth generation has no external observations for predictive calibration.
unavailable_findings.EDGE_CONTRASTS_EXPLICIT: Edge knockout experiments are separate from generating the recorded dataset.
unavailable_findings.NO_RELAXATION_TERM: The deterministic accumulator and static baseline have no relaxation term.
unavailable_findings.STATIC_CONSTRUCT: The baseline is constant within each history.
unavailable_findings.INSUFFICIENT_TIMES: The exact driver reading and known accumulator origin each supply only one observation time.
unavailable_findings.INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVATIONS: A single exact reading has no estimable empirical variance.

provenance: New DSL-supported T=512 variant. Production simulate from truth artifact 5d4d9efa44fcca3d4d971104d4576907b007bc90, seed 721, one replicate; the exact call and hashes are in generation.json. The declared mask converts generated.csv to observations.csv. See assets/t512/README.md for changes from the historical fixture; its old posterior is not a reference.
